```sql
SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ST_Centroid(pr.geometry::geography)) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
JOIN parks pr ON ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, pr.geometry::geography, 100000)
WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(pr.geometry), p.geometry) BETWEEN RADIANS(112.5) AND RADIANS(157.5)
  AND pr.park_name ILIKE '%Indian Run Falls Park - Observation Deck B%'
```

```sql
SELECT p.park_name, ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM parks p
JOIN regions r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, r.geometry)
WHERE ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) <= 170000
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(r.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5
  AND r.region_name ILIKE '%Rockford%'
  AND r.border_type = 'city'
ORDER BY distance_meters ASC;
```

SELECT park_name, leisure
FROM parks

                 (SELECT ST_Centroid(pois.geometry)::geography 
                  FROM pois 
                  WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' 
                    AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' 
                    AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' 
                  LIMIT 1), 40000)
  AND ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(parks.geometry), 
                 (SELECT ST_Centroid(pois.geometry) 
                  FROM pois 
                  WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' 
                    AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' 
                    AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' 
                  LIMIT 1)) > radians(157.5)
  AND ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(parks.geometry), 
                 (SELECT ST_Centroid(pois.geometry) 
                  FROM pois 
                  WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' 
                    AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' 
                    AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' 
                  LIMIT 1)) < radians(202.5);
